bug_semantics: In the dibs layer (net/dibs, drivers/dibs), dmb_clientid_arr was allocated in dibs_dev_alloc()/dibs_dev_add() but freed in dibs_dev_del() (and once more on the dibs_lo_dev_probe() failure path), i.e., at device removal rather than at object release. Two consequences: (1) a dibs device interrupt handler (dibs_client_ops->handle_irq consumers introduced with the data-path move) can still be running and dereference dibs->dmb_clientid_arr after dibs_dev_del() frees it — use-after-free; (2) the probe-failure unwind path frees dmb_clientid_arr twice — double free (CWE-415/CWE-416).
flaw_origin: Commit cc21191b584c6f7836b0f10774f8278b7cbfba10 ("dibs: Move data path to dibs layer", 2025-09-18, author Alexandra Winter <wintera@linux.ibm.com>, committer Paolo Abeni) introduced all the advisory-named lifecycle lines: allocation `dibs->dmb_clientid_arr = kzalloc(max_dmbs, GFP_KERNEL); memset(dibs->dmb_clientid_arr, NO_DIBS_CLIENT, max_dmbs);` in the dibs_dev_add path, use by the interrupt/IRQ path `client_id = dibs->dmb_clientid_arr[sba_idx]`, and frees `kfree(dibs->dmb_clientid_arr)` placed in the del/unwind paths instead of dibs_dev_release(). The parent tree (719c3b67bb7ea95bb8158b03c75641c8fc8f94a0) lacks net/dibs/dibs_main.c entirely (cat-file -e fails) — dmb_clientid_arr does not exist before this commit (the sibling creation commit 35758b0032c0 'dibs: Create drivers/dibs' contains zero dmb_clientid_arr lines). The fix commit's own Fixes: tag cites cc21191b584c, confirming the BIC.
